arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Robert Owen argued the Civil Rights Act permits this federal claim.
He stated the only issue is federal court access to evidence.
Justice Alito questioned if the claim avoids Rooker-Feldman doctrine.
He noted habeas corpus is not subject to claim preclusion.
